sector_verification_note: Sector 1 contains ZERO Tier A professions — nothing in computing is statutorily licensed in India. Almost every record is Tier C judgment. The only verified facts here are the JEE/class-12 subject gates, from data/verified_facts.json.

professions.one_liner: Writes the code behind apps and websites people use every day.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream. Maths helps but BCA and B.Sc IT accept most streams.
B.Tech CSE, BCA or B.Sc Computer Science (3-4 years)
Working projects on GitHub — this is what actually gets you hired

entrance_exams.note: State engineering entrances also apply. No exam needed for most BCA/B.Sc seats.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Freelance and contract development, or founding a product company.

ai_exposure.reason: Syntax and boilerplate are skill, and that is what AI now does. What remains is deciding what to build, how it should behave at the edges, and why the last approach failed. Junior implementation work shrinks; deciding what is worth implementing does not.

nuances.statement: Smart Contract Engineer is retained here after Blockchain was dropped as a standalone profession. The Indian Web3 market is too thin to support a separate career, but the role exists inside general development.

professions.one_liner: Builds and looks after websites and online shops for small businesses, usually freelance.

path_to_entry.requirement: Learn WordPress or Shopify — free, online, no gatekeeper
Build 3-5 real sites, even unpaid, for local businesses
Freelance platforms or local word of mouth

entrance_exams.note: No entrance exam. This is the lowest-barrier entry point in the sector.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Freelance from the first client, then a small agency. This is the most common self-employment in Sector 1 and also the most exposed to no-code tools taking the low end.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost pure execution skill on digital output, which is the most exposed combination in the sector. What survives is the client relationship — knowing a local business well enough to run their store. Building the pages themselves is already largely automated. Raised clarity 20->25. The durable part of this work is understanding what a local business actually needs versus what they asked for — that is 'for whom' clarity. Page-building itself is fully exposed.

nuances.statement: Demand is declining. Wix, Shopify and no-code builders have absorbed most of the simple brochure-and-catalogue work that defined this job, and generative tools are taking the rest of the low end. What survives is integration, performance and commerce operations for businesses that have outgrown a template. Still listed - Indian small business is enormous and the work has not vanished - but the direction is down.

admin_review.reason: SELF-EMPLOYMENT CEILING OWED. Employed mid-career is 4.5 lakh and people in this profession routinely go independent, but no reliable Indian figure was found for what they earn once they do. Until it exists the record understates the profession, which is exactly the defect this field was added to fix. The route is recorded; the number is not.

professions.one_liner: Builds video games and 3D interactive worlds — the code, the rules and the environments.

deviating_roles.why: Designers decide what is fun and why a world feels alive — imaginative, meaning-driven work. Programmers on the same team live in engine internals and precise state. Same profession, opposite temperaments.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
Game development diploma, or self-taught Unity/Unreal
2-3 finished playable games or XR demos. Studios hire on this, not marks.

entrance_exams.note: Portfolio-based hiring. Private game/animation institutes admit without an entrance exam.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Indie studio or contract development for larger studios.

ai_exposure.reason: Asset production and boilerplate gameplay code are exposed. Judging what is actually fun, and why a level feels wrong, is clarity that does not transfer to a model.

nuances.statement: AR and VR development is merged in here rather than standing alone. The engines are the same - Unity and Unreal - the studios are largely the same, and India's standalone XR market is small. Confirmed as a merge rather than a separate profession.

professions.one_liner: Teaches computers to recognise patterns, predict things and answer in language.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream, but Maths makes this far easier
B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc CS/Statistics/Maths (3-4 years)
Strong linear algebra and probability, plus real ML projects

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Independent consulting or founding a product company, on the strength of a portfolio.

ai_exposure.reason: Model training is increasingly automated. Framing the problem, judging whether the data answers the question, and deciding when the model is good enough to ship are not.

nuances.statement: The early band reflects a hiring market that has moved fast in both directions. Treat the ceiling as cycle-dependent rather than structural.

Tagged undergrad because that is what the hiring market overwhelmingly screens on, not because the knowledge is unreachable otherwise. This is the profession in Sector 1 where a demonstrated portfolio - published models, competition results, real deployed systems - most often overrides the absence of a matching degree. The tag is the destination and the usual door; it is not the only door.

The widest band in the taxonomy, and the width is real rather than an artefact. The same job title covers someone fine-tuning an existing model against a vendor API and someone training models at scale in a research-adjacent team, and Indian pay for the second is set by a small global market while pay for the first is set by ordinary IT services rates.

professions.one_liner: Turns messy company data into charts and answers that help people decide.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
Analytics certification — Excel, SQL, Power BI or Tableau
3-4 dashboards built on real public datasets

entrance_exams.note: No entrance exam. Certification and portfolio route.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Freelance analytics and dashboard work for small businesses.

ai_exposure.reason: Reporting and dashboard-building is skill on digital output — squarely in the blast radius. Product Analyst survives because it depends on knowing which question is worth asking and arguing for a decision.

nuances.statement: Tagged certificate because the certification-plus-portfolio route genuinely works in India. Many employers still screen on a degree, so the route is real but not frictionless.

professions.one_liner: Builds the pipes and storage that carry a company's data safely from place to place.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
B.Tech, BCA or B.Sc Computer Science
SQL, Python, and a cloud data stack

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

ai_exposure.reason: Pipeline boilerplate is generated well by AI. Judging correctness, cost and what to do when data is wrong at 3am is clarity with real consequences.

professions.one_liner: Defends computer systems from attack, and tests them by trying to break in first.

deviating_roles.why: Breaking in rewards lateral, rule-bending curiosity. The GRC and compliance side of the same profession rewards the opposite: procedure, documentation and firm adherence to a standard.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
CompTIA Security+, CEH, or OSCP for the offensive side
Capture-the-flag competitions and home lab work

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Independent penetration testing and audit practice, always under written scope.

ai_exposure.reason: L1 alert triage is skill and heavily exposed. Adversarial judgement — attackers adapt, so the right response is never a fixed procedure — is clarity, as is being the accountable human during a breach.

nuances.statement: Tagged certificate rather than undergrad on the strength of how hiring actually works: OSCP, CEH, CISSP and equivalent certifications are what employers screen on, and the field takes entrants from IT support and networking backgrounds without a security degree. A computer science degree helps and is the common path; it is not the gate.

Penetration Tester and Red Team Analyst are offensive-security roles, and the skills are the same ones an attacker uses. What separates the profession from the crime is authorisation - a signed scope agreement before any testing - and that distinction belongs in front of a school-age student at the point the role is shown, not after.

professions.one_liner: Keeps apps running on the internet — fast, always on, and cheap to run.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
AWS, Azure or Google Cloud associate certification
Deploy and run your own projects end to end

entrance_exams.note: Vendor certification route, no entrance exam.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Independent cloud consulting, usually after certifications and production experience.

ai_exposure.reason: Config and scripting is exposed. Deciding architecture trade-offs, and being answerable when production is down, is not.

professions.one_liner: Hunts for bugs and broken behaviour before customers ever see them.

deviating_roles.why: Manual QA is sustained, patient, detail-holding work. SDET and performance testing are programming jobs and want the abstraction and problem-decomposition the manual side does not.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
Software testing certification (ISTQB is the common one)
Move to automation early — Selenium or Playwright

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

ai_exposure.reason: Manual QA is the highest skill-to-clarity ratio in the sector: repetitive execution on digital output. SDET and performance testing carry more clarity and are materially safer. Anyone entering should target automation from day one.

nuances.statement: The high band is driven by MANUAL QA. SDET and performance testing sit in a materially different position. Anyone entering should target automation from day one rather than manual testing.

professions.one_liner: Fixes the computers, wifi and networks an office runs on.

deviating_roles.why: Helpdesk is a people job wearing a technical coat — the daily skill is calming someone and hearing what they actually mean. Network and NOC engineering on the same ladder is solitary and systems-shaped.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
ITI or polytechnic diploma in computer hardware and networking
CompTIA A+ or Cisco CCNA to move up

entrance_exams.note: ITI/polytechnic admission is on class 10 marks, not an entrance exam.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Own AMC business maintaining IT for small offices and shops.

ai_exposure.reason: Skill-heavy but most of that skill is physical — crimping cable, replacing hardware, walking to a site. L1 phone scripts are exposed; field and network work is not. Raised clarity 20->25. Helpdesk work is the classic gap between what a user reports and what is actually wrong — diagnosing the real problem behind the stated one is 'what' and 'for whom' clarity.

nuances.statement: Listed as a destination, and it is a real one: network, systems and NOC work is a durable career with certification ladders - CCNA onwards - that raise pay without a degree. It is also the cheapest technical entry point in this sector, which is why the low band is not the whole story. A student should know both that it pays least at entry and that it is one of the few routes into cloud and infrastructure work that does not require an engineering seat.

professions.one_liner: Writes the code that lives inside machines — cars, meters, drones, smart devices.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics and Maths compulsory, plus one of Chemistry/Biology/Vocational
JEE Main Paper 1, or a state or private engineering entrance
B.Tech in Electronics, ECE or Electrical (4 years)
Embedded C, microcontrollers, hands-on board work

entry_window.constrained_route: JEE Main — admits only recent class 12 passouts
bypass: 3-year engineering diploma, then lateral entry into B.Tech year 2 (generally no upper age limit)
B.Sc graduate lateral entry into B.Tech year 2

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

ai_exposure.reason: Protected on two layers at once: deep foundational knowledge of how hardware actually behaves, plus physical bench work. Debugging a board with an oscilloscope is not a text problem.

nuances.statement: The lateral-entry bypass is reliable at national level. AICTE norms set NO maximum age for diploma-to-B.Tech lateral entry, so the three-year JEE window constrains one route and not the profession. What varies is the state: some state LEET rules and some institutions apply an 18 to 26 band, and the diploma aggregate requirement runs 45 to 50 percent. A student should check their own state's LEET, but no state closes the door outright.

professions.one_liner: Sets up and customises the big software that large companies run on.

deviating_roles.why: Functional consulting is sitting with a client's finance team and drawing out how they really work. The developer roles beside it — ABAP, Apex — are solitary technical build work.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream. Commerce is genuinely useful for the finance modules.
Any bachelor's — B.Com and BBA are common routes, not just B.Tech
SAP, Salesforce or ServiceNow platform certification

entrance_exams.note: No specialised entrance. Platform certification after graduation is the real gate.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Independent implementation consulting, usually after certification and client relationships.

ai_exposure.reason: Platform configuration is exposed. Sitting with a client's finance team to work out why their process is the way it is, and owning a migration that could halt their business, is clarity. Raised clarity 40->45. The job is understanding why a client's finance or supply process is the way it is before changing it. Strongly 'for whom' — configuration is the exposed part.

nuances.statement: RPA and no-code automation are merged in here as enterprise tooling rather than kept as a separate career. The work is configuring a vendor platform against a client's process, which is this profession's skill set applied to a different tool. Confirmed as a merge.

professions.one_liner: Sits between users and coders, and turns 'what we need' into 'what to build'.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
Any bachelor's — BBA, B.Com, BCA and B.Tech all work
SQL, requirement documentation, and a domain (banking, retail, health)

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

ai_exposure.reason: Now the safest desk job in the sector. Drafting is exposed, but 55% of the work is getting people who disagree to state what they actually want — that is clarity and it does not erode.

nuances.statement: Sits in Software & Computing rather than Business because in Indian IT services this is a technical job family — SQL, systems, requirements. The craft is closer to computing than to management.

professions.one_liner: Builds the software tools and pipelines that film and animation studios use to make effects.

deviating_roles.why: Technical artists sit between art and code and are judged on whether a shot looks right. Pipeline and tools developers on the same team are judged on whether the system holds under load.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream, but Maths is close to essential here
B.Tech CSE, B.Sc CS, or a VFX/animation diploma for the pipeline track
Python tools for Maya or Houdini, or rendering demos with source code

entrance_exams.note: VFX and animation institutes admit on portfolio, without an entrance exam.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

self_employment.route: Freelance for studios, or a small pipeline and tools shop.

ai_exposure.reason: Revised down from high. Generative models hit execution skill hard, but pipeline and tools work is increasingly about design judgement — knowing what artists need and what a shot should look like — rather than hand-crafting output. The skill layer erodes; the design clarity does not.

routed_elsewhere.why: The craft is design, not computing.
Managing a product is a management profession whatever the product is.
All writing professions share one parent; the subject is a tag.
Academic/lab research track. Industry AI research stays here as a job role.
Craft is visual art. The tools-and-pipeline side stays here as VFX & Graphics Technical Developer.
The job is selling, not computing.
Hardware design. Software-on-hardware stays here as Embedded Developer. Listed in Sector 2 under this exact name, with VLSI Design Engineer as a job role.
Goal is biological knowledge; computing is the instrument.
Applied to land, forest and climate questions.

removed_in_v3.why: Thin and volatile Indian market post-2022. Not defensible to present to a 10th-grader as a destination career. Smart Contract Engineer retained as a job role under Software Developer.

removed_in_v3.action: merged into Game & Interactive Media Developer
removed_in_v3.why: Identical Unity/Unreal skillset and the same studios. India's standalone XR market is too small to justify a separate profession.
Power Platform and RPA are enterprise tooling. As a standalone destination it was the most AI-exposed entry in the sector.

boundary_decisions_needing_your_signoff: Research-as-a-career: academic/lab CS research sits in Sector 3, mirroring the teaching-anything rule. Industry AI research stays here as a job role.
IT Business Analyst kept here (not Sector 5) because the day-to-day skill set is SQL, systems and requirements, and in India it is an IT-services job family.
Website & Online Store Builder kept separate from Software Developer because degree_dependency differs (none vs undergrad) — load-bearing for a recommender serving students with no degree path.

3.0: 17 -> 14 professions. Removed Blockchain; merged AR/VR into Game Developer; merged No-Code into Enterprise Consultant.
Computer Graphics Programmer reframed as VFX & Graphics Technical Developer — 'graphics engine programmer' barely exists in India, VFX pipeline work does.
Added ai_exposure (protections/exposures checklist, net score, band, reason at job-role level).
Added after_undergrad and self_employment for the college and early-professional journeys.
entrance_exams restructured into national + private_reputed. Government-only was a false picture.
entry_window flattened so machine-readable fields (max_years_since_class12, max_age, is_hard_block) are separate from explanatory text.
cost_of_entry_inr withdrawn — the figures were estimates, not research.
2.0: Rebuilt on schema with path_to_entry, verification, subject-set prerequisites.
1.1: Data Analyst and Cybersecurity downgraded undergrad -> certificate under the strict test.
4.0: ai_exposure replaced with the knowledge/skill/clarity model. Knowledge was commoditised by the internet, skill is being commoditised by AI, clarity is not. exposure_raw = knowledge + skill, but skill counts only when output is digital — physical skill is a moat, not a liability.
VFX & Graphics Technical Developer revised high -> medium. The work is shifting from execution skill to design judgement, which is clarity.
Removed 'Solution Architect' job role — professions and their roles are entry identities, not seniority tiers.
5.0: Knowledge split into foundational vs retrievable; skill split into physical vs digital. Exposure = retrievable_knowledge + digital_skill. Protection = foundational_knowledge + physical_skill + clarity.

Foundational knowledge is protective, not exposed: mental models are what let you reason at all, judge whether an AI answer is right, and direct the tool. Only lookup knowledge was commoditised by the internet.
Dropped the output_is_physical boolean — the split now lives inside the composition, which handles mixed professions a flag could not.
Bands recalibrated to the narrower exposure range: high >=65, medium 40-64, low <40.
legal_accountability retained as a separate dampener — it moves the band down one step, because a licensed human must still sign even when the underlying tasks automate.
6.0: Added cost_barrier — SPARSE and verified-only, null unless money is a primary gate. Commercial Pilot is the first populated case at 35-80 lakh self-funded, which is a bigger barrier than any exam in this dataset. This is the disciplined version of the cost_of_entry field withdrawn earlier: no universal estimates, only the handful of cases where cost decides.

Added earning_note — flags where entry_salary_band_inr systematically understates, chiefly trades and freelance-heavy professions where self-employment is common. Qualitative by design; no fabricated numbers.
7.0: Replaced entry_salary_band_inr and earning_note with a three-part economics block: cost_of_entry_lakh, early_earnings_lpa (years 1-3), mid_career_lpa (years 5-8, EMPLOYED only), and derived payback_years.

Entry pay alone was structurally biased toward long credentialed runways — it compared a 19-year-old welder with zero debt against a 22-year-old engineer with 6 lakh of fees and called the welder poorer.
mid_career explicitly EXCLUDES business ownership. If a plumber's income depends on running a contracting firm, the earning attribute is entrepreneurship (Sector 5), not plumbing.

cost_of_entry is now universal rather than sparse, because the payback ratio needs a denominator. Anchored on verified fee data: government ITI 0.05-0.4 L, government B.Tech ~6 L, private B.Tech ~13 L, CPL 35-80 L.
8.0: Added shipping block, DERIVED from data/filter_rules.json — never hand-set. Professions failing the compensation filter are flagged ship:false and RETAINED, not deleted.

Kept rather than deleted for three reasons: the 4.5 threshold is calibrated for urban India and a tier-3 threshold would differ; the threshold is a product decision that will be tuned; and a flag can be rendered as a delete while a delete cannot be rendered as a flag.
9.0: Removed the stored shipping block. ship/filtered is a DERIVED value — computable any time from economics.mid_career_midpoint + ai_exposure.band + data/filter_rules.json. Storing a derived value only creates drift risk. The rule lives in filter_rules.json; the application evaluates it at query time.
10.0: Re-scored clarity across the sector under the sharpened definition — clarity of OBJECTIVE and PROBLEM: what, how, FOR WHOM, and why. The 'for whom' dimension was previously underweighted.
Replaced the shipping block with a single derived boolean `filter`. True = passes the compensation rule in data/filter_rules.json. Validated on every export so it cannot drift.
11.0: Added nuances — a list of {field, statement, source?} recording settled subtleties where a tag value alone would mislead.
RULE: nuances are SETTLED, admin_review is UNSETTLED. A nuance is something true we already know; an admin_review is a decision a human still owes. Without that line nuances becomes a dumping ground.
Every nuance must name a field that actually exists on the record — validator-enforced.
The Architect title-protection note moved out of admin_review.reason, where it did not belong.
12.0: Cross-file reconciliation: routed_elsewhere said 'VLSI / Chip Design Engineer' but Sector 2 names it 'Chip Design Engineer'. A promise must name its destination exactly.
13.0: Added demand_signal { india_demand, pathway } — two ORTHOGONAL questions that were being conflated.

india_demand asks whether society needs this work. pathway asks where you can realistically train for it: 'india', 'any', or 'abroad'. A weak Indian pathway is NOT weak demand — India imports most medical devices, which is evidence of demand, not absence of it.
pathway deliberately does NOT rate Indian institutions as strong or weak. It states where the training exists, which is factual and actionable, rather than passing judgment on colleges.
14.0: PART B. Added role_spread — records which job roles inside a profession deviate from its baseline, and on which of the 19 psychometric factors.

higher/lower are RELATIVE to the profession's own profile, never absolute scores. Actual scoring stays in the separate psychometric pipeline; this only flags internal variance so the pipeline and the UI know where one profession contains two different people.
Factor names are constrained by data/psychometric_factors.json and every named role must exist in that profession's job_roles — both validator-enforced.
6 of 14 professions in this sector are 'wide'.
15.0: RESEARCH BATCH. Four admin_review items closed.

AI/ML Engineer: the wide band is real, not an artefact - the same title covers API fine-tuning at IT services rates and model training at global-market rates. Undergrad tier kept, with a nuance that a portfolio most often overrides it in this profession specifically.

Cybersecurity Specialist: the certificate tier stands - OSCP, CEH and CISSP are what employers screen on, and the field takes entrants from IT support and networking. Offensive-security roles now carry a nuance stating that authorisation is what separates the profession from the crime, and that it belongs in front of a school-age student at the point the role is shown.
IT Support & Network Technician: confirmed as a destination, not only a stepping stone.
Embedded Software & IoT Developer: AICTE sets NO maximum age for lateral entry, so the bypass is reliable nationally; state LEET rules vary within an 18 to 26 band.
16.0: Received the Blockchain & Web3 Developer merge record from Sector 2, where it had been filed by mistake. Target corrected to 'Software Developer', which is in this sector - a merge is same-sector by definition.

merged_into.why: Thin and volatile Indian market. Smart Contract Engineer retained as a job role.
